# Gradle wrapper

`gradle-wrapper.jar` is the official jar from the Gradle **8.12.0** tag
(`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v8.12.0/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`,
SHA-256 `2db75c40782f5e8ba1fc278a5574bab070adccb2d21ca5a6e5ed840888448046`).

`./gradlew` (or `gradlew.bat` on Windows) is self-contained — no local Gradle install is needed.
To change the Gradle version, edit `gradle-wrapper.properties` and run `./gradlew wrapper` once.
